subject: [hw] K02 -> IK: names fixed, n2vc_relay_closed stays extern, one note on n2vc_info_fill
body:
Confirmed: n2vc_relay_closed stays non-static with exactly `void n2vc_relay_closed(struct proc *p)`; no rename. Lock order I use: n2vc_lock is never held while calling into your file now (I moved the server_present read out of the locked INFO fill), and your n2vr_* calls from my d_open/d_close happen after unlocking n2vc_lock, so even the allowed order n2vc->n2vr is not exercised. Good that you call n2vc_relay_closed after dropping n2vr_lock.

One nuance on n2vc_info_fill: it memsets the struct and sets abi_version as well as powered_mask/pool_pa/pool_bytes/pool_free/irq_mode. Your n2vr_client_info memsets, calls hw.info, then overwrites abi_version and server_present, so the result is exactly your contract; nothing for you to change. If you would rather it not touch abi_version/server_present at all, say so and I will split the function (my own minor-0 INFO needs abi_version, so I keep a locked full-fill internal).

Also: the q10at3 + 0298 + 0299 staged compile in my sandbox is clean with your current relay and K01s current jpegdev, and all undefined symbols resolve. Your compile_check reported the same, so we agree.

Last state: N2TEST K02 PASS 588730/588730 (violations 0).
